definition_zh: 保险杠；缓冲器； bumper 亦指“异常丰硕的”（形容词）
definition_en: a device that absorbs shock at the front or rear of a vehicle; a bumper crop is an unusually large one
core_image: 车头的横杠，替车身先挨撞
scene: 停车场里两车轻轻一碰，横杠上留下道白痕。The old car's bumper was dented in the collision.
sceneCN: 这里 bumper 是「保险杠」（第 1 个义项：吸收撞击的部件）；句意是旧车的保险杠在碰撞中凹了。

pos.zh: 丰盛的，异常大的（如 bumper crop 丰收）

collocations.zh: （车流）一辆接一辆，堵得水泄不通

derivatives.zh: bumper 的基础词，义为「碰撞，撞上」
由 bump 加 -y 构成，义为「颠簸的」
复合词，义为「（贴在）保险杠上的标语贴纸」

senses.title: A shock-absorbing bar on a vehicle
senses.definition: a horizontal bar at the front or rear of a vehicle that absorbs minor impacts
senses.definitionCN: 车辆前后吸收轻微撞击的横杠
senses.example: The parking bump cracked the rear bumper.
senses.exampleCN: 停车时的轻碰弄裂了后保险杠。
senses.why: The agent suffix -er names the thing that takes the bump.
senses.whyCN: 施动后缀 -er 把「承受碰撞之物」命名为 bumper。

senses.title: Any cushioning device
senses.definition: any padded or springy device that softens a blow
senses.definitionCN: 缓和撞击的任何软垫或弹性装置
senses.example: Pool tables have rubber bumpers on the rails.
senses.exampleCN: 台球桌边装有橡胶缓冲垫。
senses.why: The vehicle part generalizes to wherever impact must be absorbed.
senses.whyCN: 车辆部件推广到一切需要吸震之处。

senses.title: Unusually large or abundant
senses.titleCN: 丰盛的，异常大的（形容词）
senses.definition: exceptionally large or plentiful, as of crops, crowds or seasons
senses.definitionCN: （收成、客流、季期等）异常丰硕、旺盛的
senses.example: Rains brought a bumper wheat crop.
senses.exampleCN: 降雨带来了小麦大丰收。
senses.why: A full bump — a swollen, rounded abundance — stretched into the adjective.
senses.whyCN: 「鼓胀饱满」之象延伸出丰硕之义，名词义转为形容词。

intro.en: Bumper is bump plus the agent suffix -er, from an imitative root.
intro.cn: bumper 由拟声动词 bump 加施动后缀 -er 构成。

items.en: bump arose in the sixteenth century, echoing the sound of a dull blow.
items.cn: bump 十六世纪出现，摹仿沉闷的撞击声。

items.en: bumper first named a full cup of ale, drunk at a gulp.
items.cn: 十七世纪 bumper 初指一满杯麦酒，须一饮而尽。

items.en: the sense of swollen fullness gave the adjective bumper crop.
items.cn: 「满胀」之义衍生出形容词 bumper crop（大丰收）。

items.en: motorcars adopted bumper for the impact bar.
items.cn: 十九至二十世纪汽车以 bumper 称撞击横杠。

items.en: bumper now spans car parts, cushions and abundant yields.
items.cn: 如今 bumper 兼指车用部件、缓冲装置与丰硕产出。

note.en: Bumper sits in the bump family and by its fellow impact-absorbers.
note.cn: bumper 属 bump 词族，与同类吸震词为邻。

entries.definition: a light blow; a raised area
entries.definitionCN: 碰撞；隆起处，bumper 的基础词

entries.definition: cars packed so close they nearly touch
a slogan stuck on a car bumper
a guard over a wheel or at the front of a car
entries.definitionCN: 挡泥板；护杠，美式常与 bumper 混称

entries.definition: the highest yet, as a record harvest
entries.definitionCN: 创纪录的，与 bumper crop 义近的修饰语
（年份、季期）极好的，banner year 与 bumper year 对应

normalIntro.en: It is the thing that takes the bump so the car does not.
normalIntro.cn: 它就是替车身挨撞的那道杠。

normal.en: Bump is the sound of a dull blow; add -er.
normal.cn: bump 是闷响，加上 -er 即可。

normal.en: The oldest bumper was a full mug of ale.
normal.cn: 最早的 bumper 是一大满杯麦酒。

normal.en: Fullness gives the adjective: a bumper crop.
Bumper to bumper paints the traffic jam.
normal.cn: bumper to bumper 描出堵车画面。

normal.en: Banner year and bumper year mean the same.
normal.cn: banner year 与 bumper year 同义。

abstract.en: Feel a soft thud travel through a rubber bar.
abstract.cn: 感受闷响穿过橡胶横杠。

abstract.en: See a grain truck overflow with golden wheat.
abstract.cn: 看见运粮车满得溢出金黄麦粒。

abstract.en: Hear pool balls click against the rubber rails.
abstract.cn: 听台球撞上橡胶库边的一声脆响。

examples.en: Traffic was bumper to bumper for two hours.
examples.cn: 堵车堵得一辆贴着一辆，持续了两个小时。

examples.en: A bumper crowd filled the stadium.
He backed into a pole and bent the bumper.
examples.cn: 他倒车撞上立柱，保险杠撞弯了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「碰」——bumper 就是替车「碰」的那道杠，先撞它，别撞车。

root: bumper 由拟声动词 bump（撞、碰，十六世纪见于英语）加施动后缀 -er 构成，指「承受碰撞之物」；早期义「满杯酒」由「鼓胀」之象引申出形容词「丰盛的」，词源无拉丁成分。

sensesIntro.en: The thing that takes the bump widens into any shock absorber, and its sense of fullness yields the adjective of abundance.
sensesIntro.cn: 「承受撞击之物」推广为一切缓冲器，其「满胀」之义又衍出「丰盛」的形容词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a horizontal bar meeting the blow first.
core.cn: 核心意象：一道横杠先迎上撞击。

branches.en: rubber bumpers on a pool table
a bumper season at the box office

intro.en: Bumper is an agent noun of an imitative verb: bump plus -er.
intro.cn: bumper 是拟声动词的施动名词：bump 加 -er。

latinIntro.en: The root is imitative English; no Latin stem exists.
latinIntro.cn: 词根为英语拟声词，并无拉丁词干。

items.meaning: to hit with a heavy blow
